rule: A deterministic algorithm may never depend on LLM code or on data an LLM produced. Deterministic output must be reproducible from seeds in git alone, which is impossible if any step reads a cache or aggregate a model wrote.
_quarantined_comment: LLM-owned files. They may talk to a model. Nothing outside this list may import them. Moving a file OUT of this list means its LLM dependency was cut.
_pending_cut_comment: Deterministic code that still reaches LLM code. Each entry is a bug with a known fix, not an accepted dependency. The checker fails on any file NOT in either list, so this set can only shrink. Cutting an entry means deleting the LLM branch, not moving the file.

pending_cut.tools/fonoran-translator.js: THE DETERMINISTIC ENGINE, and the worst leak here. It imports promoteTemporalSceneToTime, applyDisjunction and isAddresseeDroppable from fonoran-llm-grammar-brief.js. Those three are grammar rules, not LLM code: they are only housed in an LLM-named file. Fix: move them to a neutral grammar module that both sides import. No behaviour change, so this is the cheapest cut on the list and should be first.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-translate-alternates.js: Same three grammar helpers, same fix.
pending_cut.scripts/fonoran-parser-corpus-compare.js: Inherits via fonoran-translator.js and fonoran-translation-gaps.js, which it imports only to score the two parse front ends against the golden corpus. This entry disappears with the translator cut below; nothing else needs doing.
Inherits via fonoran-translator.js, which it imports only to compare the current parse against a POS-tagger parse. This entry disappears the moment the translator cut above lands; nothing else needs doing.
pending_cut.scripts/fonoran-optimize-compounds.js: Imports fonoran-llm-aggregate.js to report model scores alongside four-rules output. Fix: drop the column, or move the script into the quarantine.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-translate.js: Statically imports the LLM engine and the reverse-translate fluency layer, so every consumer loads LLM code even though the deterministic engine is already the default. Fix: drop engine=llm from the unified API and let quarantined scripts call fonoran-llm-translate directly.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-reverse-translate.js: Fonoran to English has a working deterministic lexical glosser plus an LLM fluency layer on top. Fix: split the fluency layer into the quarantine, keep the glosser.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-translation-gaps.js: Inherits via fonoran-translate.js. Also drives the golden baseline that npm test asserts with --engine llm --cache-only, which should assert the deterministic baseline instead.
pending_cut.scripts/fonoran-translation-gaps.js: Inherits. Its --engine llm flag should go.
pending_cut.scripts/fonoran-translation-probes.js: Inherits. Its --engine llm flag should go.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-course-phrases-compile.js: Learn phrase roman is compiled from the LLM translation cache at runtime. Fix: compile from the deterministic engine, which removes the cache dependency entirely.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-course-phrases-build.js: Inherits from the compiler plus a direct llm-translate import.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-api.js: Serves LLM pipeline and LLM candidate routes alongside deterministic ones. Fix: move those routes behind a quarantined router that is not mounted by default.
pending_cut.server.js: Inherits via fonoran-api.js, so booting the site loads the LLM pipeline. A likely contributor to slow local page loads.
pending_cut.js/fonoran-advanced-page.js: Hosts the LLM pipeline wizard UI.
pending_cut.js/tests.js: Inherits via fonoran-translate.js and the course-phrases tests.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-proposal-gate.js: Imports fonoran-llm-intuition to gate proposals. Fix: gate on four-rules scoring and human review only.
pending_cut.scripts/fonoran-refine-loop.js: Inherits via the gap analyzer and proposal gate.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-store.js: Reads the LLM playtests document. Fix: the store may hold it, but no deterministic reader may consult it.
